'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Illustrated joke sheet (border: site-rules gag; deck note Probe of Uranus…); dest [[Brian Herold]]. Sheet '''Imperial Occupation v'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation|Imperial Occupation (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
